stop_reason: No exercise contrast: every sequenced group is defined by disease induction (L-NAME + HFD), time point, or drug treatment (EMPA, PFD, EMPA+PFD, PBS vehicle). Exercise appears only as a treadmill exhaustion test used as a functional outcome (S3.5.p1, S4.1.p4); no animal was exercise-trained, so the data cannot identify an effect of exercise on gene expression.
